platformLimits.note: The n8n node UI has no runtime catalogue fetch: methods.loadOptions runs inside the n8n server, so the provider/model pickers read catalog.json, a models.dev snapshot regenerated at build time by `npm run catalog` (part of `npm run build`).

n8n exposes no node-UI i18n API (node descriptions are English-only literals consumed by the editor). All user-facing strings therefore live in the INodeProperties `displayName`/`description`/`placeholder` fields of nodes/Dualtran/Dualtran.node.ts, in one place, ready for a future catalogue; the 44 target-language labels come from scripts/catalog-sources/language-names.json.
